reference: He raised both arms above his head while the hall went loud.
sk: Zdvihol obe ruky nad hlavu, zatiaľ čo sála zaburácala.
cz: Zvedl obě ruce nad hlavu, zatímco sál zaburácel.
acceptable: He {raised|lifted|put up} both {arms|hands} {above|over} his head while the {hall|audience|crowd} {roared|erupted}.
He {raised|lifted} both his {arms|hands} {above|over} his head while the {hall|crowd} {roared|erupted}.
He {raised|lifted} both {arms|hands} {above|over} his head while the {hall|crowd} {was roaring|went wild}.
While the {hall|crowd} {roared|erupted}, he {raised|lifted} both {arms|hands} {above|over} his head.

mistakes.text: Both arms were raised above his head while the hall {went loud|roared}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ruky zdvihol on sám, preto patrí Active: „He raised both arms“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ruce zvedl on sám, proto sem patří Active: „He raised both arms“.
mistakes.feedback_en: He does the action himself, so use Active: “He raised both arms”.

mistakes.text: He was raised both arms above his head while the hall {went loud|roared}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ruky zdvihol on sám, preto patrí Active „He raised“, nie Passive „was raised“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ruce zvedl on sám, proto patří Active „He raised“, ne Passive „was raised“.
mistakes.feedback_en: He lifted his arms himself, so use Active “He raised”, not Passive “was raised”.

mistakes.text: He rised both arms above his head while the hall {went loud|roared}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: S predmetom sa používa „raise – raised“; „rise – rose“ je bez predmetu.
mistakes.feedback_cz: S předmětem se používá „raise – raised“; „rise – rose“ je bez předmětu.
mistakes.feedback_en: With an object use “raise – raised”; “rise – rose” takes no object.

mistakes.text: He raised both arms above the head while the hall {went loud|roared}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri častiach tela patrí privlastňovacie zámeno: „his head“, nie „the head“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U částí těla patří přivlastňovací zájmeno: „his head“, ne „the head“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With body parts English uses a possessive: “his head”, not “the head”.

mistakes.text: He has raised both arms above his head while the hall {went loud|roared}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o ukončený dej v minulom príbehu, preto Past Simple „raised“, nie Present Perfect.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o ukončený děj v minulém příběhu, proto Past Simple „raised“, ne Present Perfect.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is a finished action in a past story, so use Past Simple “raised”.

source_issues: English “the hall went loud” is unnatural; Slovak “zaburácala” / Czech “zaburácel” mean “roared”, which is accepted.
